Plz plz tell me a dua or zikr for passing in the Exam. Question: I failed in my H.S.C exam in physics. I have given exam again. But my exam did not become well. Plz plz tell me a dua or zikr for passing in the Exam. Answer ID: 22301 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 788/788/M=1431) Hard work is the key to success. If you do full preparation for the examination and write correct answers, then in-sha-Allah you will surely secure excellent. After each salah, recite the following surah seven times with durood 11-11 times before and after: إذا جاء نصر الله والفتح , ورأيت الناس يدخلون في دين الله أفواجا، فسبح بحمد ربك واستغفره إنه كان توابا [النصر : 1] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
